steps.content: In this reality as cold and dark as the deep sea, you slowly discern a colossal, malevolent presence behind you, lurking at the bottom of the Abyss, its existence so overpowering that fear verges on palpable.

Inexplicably, your memories resurface—of your former companions, of Pylgia. You failed to save her. You failed to save any of them. Your bitter regret manifests as tentacles entwining around your body and mind, attempting to drag you further into the depths.
You murmur the question, uncertain whether you are directing it towards yourself, or the presence lurking at the bottom of the Abyss.
You hear a deep resonance, like meaningless, jumbled whispers, or the final breath of a dying being.
It offers no answer to your question. How could it answer your question? From the very beginning, all it ever wanted has been to drag you deeper into the depths.
In desperation, you gaze at the entrance of the Abyss. It's now so distant that only a tiny speck of light remains.
No. There's more than one speck of light.
You struggle to lift your head, watching as the other light speck grows larger, traversing torrents of death and sorrow to reach your side.
The exact scene that you once saw in a dream.
